items.title: Assis Chateaubriand (PR) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #35
items.en_title: Assis Chateaubriand (PR) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #35
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Assis Chateaubriand (PR) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 10,743,980; proposals close Nov 26, 18:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
